subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers adopt and rebase the open fork PR for this Debug Snapshots fix, or supersede it and allow a fresh narrow fix against current main?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but an open fork PR with closing syntax already exists and automation should not create a duplicate fix until maintainers choose what to do with that PR path.

options.title: Supersede the fork path
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then allow a fresh narrow fix against the current Debug page structure with localized copy, tests, and browser proof.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor rebase the fork branch, move the change to the current files, add tests/proof, and review it as the implementation path.

recommendation.title: Supersede the fork path
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then allow a fresh narrow fix against the current Debug page structure with localized copy, tests, and browser proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the original Debug dashboard surface and is the strongest routing signal for deciding whether to adopt or replace the stale fork path.
